nodes.label: Backpatching Re-encoder (Tag.write direct writes)
nodes.rationale: 0.x encoded each element into its own temp stream and copied it twice; 1.0 writes directly into the destination, reserves the length field, and backpatches with writeUint16At/writeUint32At at absolute offsets — no per-element temporary stream, no double copy. SR writes 1.76x faster, large values 3.23x.

nodes.label: Big 16 UN Substitution (up-front header decision)
nodes.rationale: An 8-byte short header cannot be backpatched into the 12-byte Big 16 layout after the fact, so the writer decides up front: fixed-size binary VRs emit the right header immediately; variable-length values are screened by a cheap, deliberately over-estimating valueByteUpperBound, and only possible overflows take the historical measured path — with an internal guard that throws if the bound is ever wrong.

nodes.label: Passthrough Fast Path (verbatim source spans)
nodes.rationale: A lazy-read entry that was never edited still knows its exact on-disk encoding via _sourceSpan (header, value, items, delimiters, BOT, fragments); the writer skips encoding entirely and copies whole SQ subtrees and the encapsulated PixelData run in one subarray each — byte-identical, header to delimiter. Disabled per-dict by charset-unsafe sources, transfer-syntax changes, non-default encoding writeOptions, or missing lazy context.

nodes.label: Zero-Copy Windows (64 KB+ spans)
nodes.rationale: Spans of 64 KB or more appended at the stream end become read-only windows over the source buffer (referenced, not duplicated); window chunks are marked read-only so a misdirected length backpatch can never corrupt the caller's source buffer.

nodes.label: Assignment-Based Dirty Tracking (_dirty, _nestedDirtCount)
nodes.rationale: Dirtiness is assignment-based by design: absence of _dirty means dirty (eager/upsert/denaturalized entries always re-encode); nested assignments bump _nestedDirtCount up the ancestor chain; structural sequence edits that bypass setters are caught by write-time structure re-verification (sqStructureDiverged). In-place mutation is undetectable by design and documented.

nodes.label: Deflate-on-Write (PS3.10 A.5)
nodes.rationale: Preamble, DICM, and meta group written uncompressed; body produced as ELE into a scratch stream then raw-deflated (RFC 1951, mirror of the read side's inflateRaw). Passthrough composes: a deflated source's spans index the inflated body buffer, so clean entries copy verbatim into the pre-deflate stream and only the wrapper is recomputed.

nodes.label: Byte-Identity Guarantee (no-edit round trip)
nodes.rationale: For an eligible file (lazy read, same transfer syntax, default write options, passthrough-safe charset, zero edits) the dataset body reproduces byte-for-byte — a guarantee 0.x never had, pinned by round-trip suites over an adversarial fixture corpus. The meta group is always re-encoded; deflate wrapper bytes may differ.

hyperedges.label: Byte-Faithful Write Path (spans to passthrough to guarantee)
